verdict: The accepted version is a substantial revision. The theory was largely redone: pressure-dependent exchange and anisotropy, an ABC-only control that fails, and a stacking-variation TC(p) model. The magnetization was remeasured with a new cell, giving pc = 5.8 GPa, two runs and recovery after decompression, while the stacking interpretation was softened and backed by a paracrystal analysis. The quantitative phase-fraction link, low-temperature structure, the AFM phase and the Raman assignment were mostly left alone or only softened.

inferred_requests.title: Show that the stacking fraction tracks the magnetic suppression
inferred_requests.text: The R-3 fraction stays flat to ~5.7 GPa while TC drops; referees likely asked how the fraction was obtained and whether it supports the mechanism. The authors removed the fraction plot, explained the method, called it a lower bound and added caveats.

inferred_requests.title: Make the simulations reproduce the loss of ferromagnetism
inferred_requests.text: Referees likely asked for simulations that reach TC = 0 and use pressure-dependent exchange. The new version computes J1(p), JL(p) and MAE(p), shows ABC-only TC does not fall, finds TC vanishing at 73% AA and compares a simulated TC(p) to data.

inferred_requests.title: Justify the A-A stacking model against random stacking
inferred_requests.text: Referees likely questioned whether the P-3m1 subcell proves ordered A-A stacking. The authors now admit two indistinguishable scenarios, add a paracrystal analysis of reciprocal-space maps and fix the occupancy.

inferred_requests.title: Document hydrostaticity and pressure calibration
inferred_requests.text: Referees likely asked how pressure was set and read and whether the medium stays hydrostatic. The authors added overpressure error bars, a cell redesign note, loading at room temperature, a corrected 10.5 GPa limit and sample photos in two media.

inferred_requests.title: Test reversibility after decompression
inferred_requests.text: Referees likely asked for magnetization on a decompressed sample as a direct test of the stacking mechanism. The authors show FM fully recovers after 10 GPa and that XRD after 21.5 GPa keeps P-3m1.

inferred_requests.title: Firm up the critical pressure and its reproducibility
inferred_requests.text: Referees likely objected to the TC fit and asked for data near pc and for run-to-run spread. The fit is gone, a 6.24 GPa point shows no FM, AC data join the phase diagram and two runs are compared.

inferred_requests.title: Consider a thermodynamic explanation of the negative dTC/dP
inferred_requests.text: A referee likely pointed to negative thermal expansion below TC (Kozlenko et al.) and the Ehrenfest relation. The authors added a paragraph arguing it does not apply to vdW magnets.

inferred_requests.title: Place the result against prior pressure studies
inferred_requests.text: Referees likely asked for a fair account of earlier CrBr3 pressure work and the novelty claim. The introduction now details prior TC(p), Raman and strain studies.

inferred_requests.title: Tone down the claim of an antiferromagnetic high-pressure phase
inferred_requests.text: Referees likely said the data do not show an AFM phase. The abstract and conclusions now attribute the loss to AFM-coupled stackings and call for microscopic probes, without new magnetic data above pc.

inferred_requests.title: Include magnetic anisotropy and dimensionality in the TC model
inferred_requests.text: A referee likely asked about anisotropy and quasi-2D effects on TC. The authors computed MAE(p) and discuss finite-size and domain effects.

inferred_requests.title: Reconcile the Raman transition pressure with other work
inferred_requests.text: A referee likely noted the Raman pc differs from XRD and from published Raman. The authors compare their 10 GPa with 15 GPa in a new reference and reframe the mode assignment.

inferred_requests.title: Fix captions, labels and occupancy errors
inferred_requests.text: Referees likely listed copy errors. Several captions, spellings, stacking labels and the 1/3 occupancy were corrected.

issue_status.reason: The fraction plot is removed, its method stated and called a lower bound, and a caveat added; the Methods ~80% still disagrees with the 0.60 in Table S4.
Loading at room temperature is now stated, but no low-temperature structural data or reconciliation of the three critical pressures is given.
The A-A claim is softened to two indistinguishable scenarios and a paracrystal analysis added at ambient pressure; no rod or diffuse-scattering analysis of the high-pressure data.
Abstract and conclusions drop the claim of an emerging AFM phase, but no high-field, Curie-Weiss or microscopic data were added, and p. 12 still states an AFM structure.
Simulations now use pressure-dependent exchange, reach TC = 0 at 73% AA and are compared with TC(p); disorder is still site-random and M(H) is not simulated.
Hydrostatic limit corrected to 10.5 GPa, overpressure error bars, room-temperature loading and photos in two media added; no low-temperature pressure check or second medium for magnetization.
Magnetization after decompression from 10 GPa is shown: FM recovers fully.
Msat now read at 1 T and 2 K with source loops shown, but mass determination, background and demagnetization are still not described.
The wrong-sign fit is removed and a 6.24 GPa point added; the TC definition and an uncertainty on pc are still missing.
JL(p) for ABC and AA is given, but no enthalpy comparison of stackings.
The method (relative intensities of the 1/3 maxima, pure-phase assumption) and its lower-bound nature are stated.
Two runs with pc differing by ~1 GPa are shown, but initial phase fractions of the magnetization crystals are not given.
Reciprocal-space maps of an as-grown and a deformed crystal with a paracrystal model are added, yet trimorphism is now called intrinsic.
Mode assignment, the A2g label and the metallization claim are unchanged; only a comparison with a 15 GPa literature value is added.
Exchange is recomputed with r2SCAN+rVV10 and U changed to 2.8 eV, but no U scan, and D3 is still called non-local.
Measured and calculated lattice parameters are overlaid, but the 0.7 GPa c anomaly and the volume drop are not discussed.
Old Fig. 1 and the 5.9 GPa curve are replaced by the new Fig. 1, whose caption states 0.01 T.
Prior pressure work is now described in detail, but the 'first direct evidence' wording is kept.
Several caption and spelling errors are fixed; space group 150, two equations numbered (1), 'invented' and 289 vs 296 K remain.
The reference list was rebuilt, but new duplicates (Refs. 15/29, 17/38) and placeholder DOIs remain.
ABC is now used consistently for the R-3 stacking.
Table S3 still gives 0.667 without an uncertainty or statement.
The powder pattern moved to Fig. S3 without discussion of the split reflection.
The CrI3 data remain preliminary and the similarity is still called striking.

unaddressed_major.title: No low-temperature structural data under pressure
unaddressed_major.why: Low-temperature DAC diffraction is a major new experiment; the authors only added a loading statement, which fits a response that argues infeasibility.

unaddressed_major.title: No direct evidence for an AFM phase above pc
unaddressed_major.why: The wording was softened and microscopic probes deferred, but no new high-field data, suggesting a referee asked and the authors answered in the letter.

unaddressed_major.title: Raman assignment lacks symmetry analysis
unaddressed_major.why: Only a literature comparison was added; the A2g label and metallization claim are untouched, which suggests no referee pressed on symmetry.

unaddressed_major.title: Lattice-parameter anomalies and possible first-order collapse
unaddressed_major.why: The 0.7 GPa c value and the volume drop are unchanged and undiscussed.
